assumptions.structure: fully amortizing, fixed rate, no balloon (satisfies 12 CFR 1026.36(a)(5) seller-financer exemption; balloon would fail (a)(4) and risk (a)(5) interpretation)
assumptions.disclosure_rule: ads quote P&I only and always state tax ~$600/mo and HOA $65/mo are extra

conventional_benchmark.note: Benchmark only. Target buyer cannot qualify conventionally; owner finance sells access, not rate.
